PLAN "12-Week Home Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight only"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 – Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Push & Core A":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pull & Hinge A":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
          jumping_jack 2m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          inverted_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x3 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          superman 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m

      DAY Friday training 45m "Legs & Core A":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 3m
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
